visualEditor.title: Visual Editor
visualEditor.fieldsTitle: Every field of the selected section, or of the page, in its form
visualEditor.description: Visually edit your site content inline, directly on the rendered page.
visualEditor.noInlineEditing: This page's editor bridge does not support editing in place; use the properties panel.
visualEditor.sectionSelected: This section is selected. Click one of its fields to edit the text.
visualEditor.duplicateHint: Duplicate places an independent copy of this section after it, as a draft you can edit on its own.
visualEditor.sectionsNotWritable: This page's sections cannot be reordered from here: it does not carry them in a 'sections' field of the length on screen.
visualEditor.sectionSaveError: Could not write the page's sections; reloading the preview
visualEditor.textMovedAppearance: Only text was edited and the appearance moved; look at the page for a reflow.
visualEditor.noPatterns: No pattern has been pushed to this instance. Capture one with shio patterns save, then shio patterns push <name>.
visualEditor.patternNeedsValues: {{name}} needs a value for {{params}}, which it has no default for. Place it with shio patterns apply {{name}} --param.
visualEditor.sectionDuplicated: Section copied — the copy is a draft of its own
visualEditor.nothingFits: This page's template says nothing can be added here.
visualEditor.typeNotProvisioned: This page's template offers {{type}}, but this instance does not have that post type yet.
visualEditor.revertField: Put this field back to what it was before you started
visualEditor.discardConfirm: Discard {{count}} pending change(s) and put every field back?
visualEditor.leaveConfirm: You have {{count}} unsaved change(s). Leave the editor and lose them?
visualEditor.noSelectionDescription: Click on an element in the page to select it and edit its properties.
visualEditor.noSitesDescription: Create a site first in the Content section, then come back here to edit it visually.
visualEditor.urlHint: Open a page of your own front end. It needs the @viglet/shio-editor-cors bridge and a urn:shio:system:editor-origin meta tag naming this console's address.
visualEditor.siteNotFound: No site resolved for '{{key}}'. Pick one from the list.
visualEditor.bridgeAbsent: This page did not hand back the editor bridge.
visualEditor.bridgeAbsentHint: You can still see it, but nothing on it is editable. Either the page failed to load, or its front end does not support inline editing yet.
